card.name: Unit size after a count of tablets
card.fires_on: The space or small linking word (of, the, tablets) right after a number of tablets, vials or packets, just before the strength of the unit is named, such as '12.5 mg tablets'.

modes.label: Space after count
modes.description: A blank gap after a count of tablets or packets, right before a strength like 12.5 mg.
